title: Appam
description: Lacy-edged, bowl-shaped Kerala rice hoppers with a soft fluffy centre, made from a fermented rice and coconut batter.
steps: Drain the soaked raw rice and grind it with the grated coconut and cooked rice, adding about 1.5 cup of water, to a smooth batter.
Stir in the sugar, yeast and salt, then cover and ferment in a warm place for 6 to 8 hours until bubbly and doubled.
The batter should flow like thin pancake batter, so add a splash of water if it seems thick.
Heat an appam pan or small kadai over medium heat and brush with a little of the coconut oil.
Pour a ladle of batter into the pan and swirl so it coats the sides and leaves a thicker centre.
Cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes until the centre is fluffy and the edges are crisp and golden; no flipping needed.
Serve hot with vegetable stew or coconut milk.
